problem.title: Basic Calculator
problem.problemStatement: Implement a calculator to evaluate an arithmetic expression containing: Non-negative integers '+' '-' Parentheses '(' and ')' Spaces The expression is guaranteed to be valid. Return the evaluated result.
problem.input: A string representing the arithmetic expression.
problem.output: A single integer representing the evaluated result.
problem.constraints: 1 <= expression.length <= 3 × 10^5 The expression contains only valid characters. Intermediate results fit within a 32-bit signed integer.
